THE PAGE PRINTS ITS OWN FOLIO AS `38`, two behind the PDF page, and that is the single most important fact about this file. The header block is reprinted at the top of every page of the run. 28 fund rows. THIS PAGE PRINTS NO TOTAL OF ITS OWN. It is page 4 of a FIVE-page table running PDF 37 to 41, and the only total the table prints is the `GRAND TOTAL` row at the foot of PDF page 41, which foots all five pages: `$3,972,219.13` | `$6,391,333.14` | `$5,787,228.78` | `$4,576,323.49`. Those four figures are NOT declared as `kind=total` in this file, because this file holds two of the five pages and declaring them here would report the three pages NOT YET TRANSCRIBED as a failure of this reading. When PDF pages 37, 38 and 39 are transcribed into this same group, the four `total` rows belong on page 41 and the group closes. WHAT IS ESTABLISHED MEANWHILE, and it is less than a printed total. (1) EVERY ONE OF THE 28 ROWS closes on the identity the table states about itself -- forward plus receipts less disbursements is the balance carried -- recomputed at the moment of transcription, zero failures. THAT IDENTITY IS NOT DECLARED AS A `check` ROW AND THE REASON IS A LIMIT OF THE VERIFIER, NOT OF THE PAGE: `verify_page_reads.py` parses `row_identity` as either all-plus (`a,b,c=d`) or minus-after-the-first (`a-b-c=d`), and `forward + receipts - disbursements = carried` is MIXED and cannot be written in either. FY2011's 159 rows and FY2013's 126 rows are in exactly this position and left it undeclared for the same reason. Declaring a wrong form and attesting the rows that then failed would attest our own limitation as the town's error. (2) The whole five-page run ties to the printed GRAND TOTAL in all four columns to the cent, 143 rows, diff 0.00 -- but that was computed against `sources/data/special-revenue-read.csv` for pages 37-39, which is a DERIVED file and not this reading, and rule 13 forbids quoting it as though it were the page. It is recorded as corroboration, not as the proof. THE RENUMBERING THIS FILE EXISTS TO FIX. `special-revenue-read.csv` numbers FY2019 by the PRINTED FOLIO while all fifteen other years carry the PDF page, so its rows for `page 38` are this page and its rows for `page 39` are PDF page 41. Every one of the 28 rows below was read independently off the bitmap and matches those rows digit for digit, which is what identifies the content rather than the label. The consequence in the tracker was two FALSE claims and two false absences: `annual-report-pages.csv` recorded PDF 35 and 36 -- which are APPROPRIATIONS pages -- as proven by `special-revenue-read`, and PDF 40 and 41 as unproven. SIGNS ARE THE DOCUMENT'S. Figures printed in PARENTHESES, in red, are recorded negative: C.O.A./M.A.R.T. Revolving opens at ($13,795.55) and closes at ($5,942.10), FY19 Earmark - Senior Center closes at ($25,000.00), Green Communities Grant at ($28,309.84). A BLANK CELL IS NOT A ZERO: 12 rows print nothing in receipts and 13 print nothing in disbursements, and those are recorded as no value, while a cell printing `$0.00` is recorded as 0.00. ROWS ARE KEYED BY PRINTED POSITION, never by name -- `fund_number` is the PDF page and the row's ordinal down it. `fund_name` carries the printed section heading then the printed program name. THE SECTION OF THE FIRST SEVEN ROWS WAS READ, NOT INFERRED: PDF page 39 ends with the heading `COUNCIL ON AGING` printed with no rows under it, and that page's folio is `37` -- a sixth independent corroboration of folio = PDF - 2. `LIBRARY`, `CEMETERIES` and `UNCLASSIFIED` are printed on this page.
